harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured and verified TLS-only local0 forwarding from RHEL 7/8/9 senders to node4 on TCP/6514. Logs are source-separated, unrelated facilities and plaintext are rejected, rotation is daily with seven compressed archives, and all four nodes retained full functionality across individual reboots.
actions_performed: Installed compatible rsyslog TLS modules on all nodes.
Generated the CA and node4 server credentials locally on node4 and distributed only the public CA certificate.
Configured authenticated TLS forwarding with persistent queues on node1-node3.
Configured node4’s TLS-only receiver, source-IP log routing, SELinux policy, and firewall.
Configured and exercised daily log rotation with seven retained compressed archives.
Tested local0 delivery, user-facility exclusion, certificate verification, and plaintext rejection.
Restarted every node individually and verified changed boot identities, persistent configuration/data, service recovery, TLS reconnection, and fresh delivery.

evidence.requirement: local0 forwarding over authenticated TLS/TCP 6514 from node1-node3
evidence.summary: Sender audits show local0-only omfwd rules using gtls and x509/name; the certificate probe verified node4 and negotiated TLS 1.2; final state shows three established 6514 sessions.

evidence.requirement: Source-identifiable application logs and exclusion of unrelated facilities
evidence.summary: Each sender’s local0 marker appeared only in its node-specific application log, while user-facility decoys remained absent before and after rotation/restarts.

evidence.requirement: No cleartext listener or plaintext ingestion
evidence.summary: A post-restart raw plaintext frame caused a TLS handshake error and was not logged; listener audits show only TCP/6514 and no TCP/UDP 514 listener.

evidence.requirement: Daily rotation, at least seven rotations, and compression
evidence.summary: The parsed policy is daily/rotate 7/compress; forced rotation produced valid gzip archives and logging continued into new current files.
Healthy baseline and boot ID 2fc81aed… were captured, reboot acknowledged, new boot ID 25913693… observed, and rsyslog/configuration/TLS delivery recovered.
Healthy baseline and boot ID 953e6cb5… were captured, reboot acknowledged, new boot ID 42184f73… observed, and rsyslog/configuration/TLS delivery recovered.
Healthy baseline and boot ID f1afbc7f… were captured, reboot acknowledged, new boot ID 48307840… observed, and rsyslog/configuration/TLS delivery recovered.

Healthy receiver/data baseline and boot ID d9f8550d… were captured, reboot acknowledged, new boot ID 2f355bff… observed, and the TLS listener, firewall, current logs, gzip history, three sessions, and fresh writes all recovered.
